layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Horizontal is one row, Vertical is one column. Podium puts the earliest first chatter in the middle and highest.

showSeconds.title: Seconds on screen after each new first

showCount.title: Show how many times they have been first

chatMessage.title: Post in chat when someone is first

message.title: Chat message
message.default: 🥇 {name} is first in chat on {platform}! First {times} so far.

skipNames.title: These names cannot be first
skipNames.description: Comma-separated. Bots (names like sery_bot) and your own channels on every platform are always skipped.

resetHours.title: New stream after this many quiet hours
resetHours.description: Everyone can be first again when a stream starts, or after chat has been quiet this long.
